newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - ICI calls in demand.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - ICI calls in demand.

text.p: A purchase of Imperial Chemical Industries Plc calls was one of the main features in a quiet options market on Thursday, dealers said.
A buyer of 500 July 750 calls at 14-1/2p was betting on recovery in the stock, which plummeted after weaker-than-expected first quarter figures.
ICI shares were down 20p at 700-1/2 by 1500 GMT.
In FTSE 100 options, volume in the 4,525 May 7 European-style calls shot to over 8,000 lots as some punters bet that the market will be sharply higher following the election on May 1.
"There has been some buying of upside volatility in the index," said one dealer. The FTSE 100 was up 5.5 points at 4,393.2 by 1505 GMT.
In American-style FTSE options volume reached over 4,000 in the May 7 4,600 calls.
Elsewhere business was quiet, dealers said. "It has been really dead," said one.
